note: WAEC Civic round 6 (R31 top-up): green light go, warning triangle, zebra priority, 50 km/h built-up limit, seat belts, stop-and-help after a knock-down, the 112 line; orderliness defined, stampede risk, national security defined, rule-of-law emergency limit; the tort; yahoo-yahoo as cybercrime, the whistleblower; referendum, voting age 18, the constituency, political tolerance; citizenship by birth never withdrawn, the alien; DSS internal and NIA external intelligence, Navy's waters, Immigration passports, Customs duties, Correctional Service reform; African Charter; inter-communal causes and settlement; peer pressure into drugs; poverty behind trafficking; justice defined; anthem author Lillian Jean Williams; hawking against the right to education; queuing to vote. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-5, NECO Civic (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
